title: I need help with this mechanic

posts.author: PixelDarkKnight0193
posts.body:
I have made a chase mechanic in RPG Maker VX Ace, it detects the player when they are 5 cubes away from the enemy, and then starts following them. When he touches it a battle begins. I have done this with the RM variables, no script.
I would like to know how to make that if after, for example, 8 seconds of chasing, it has not reached the player, it stops, if possible. Also, if the player escapes from combat, the monster should give me a few seconds to run, and if I'm still there he will chase me again. And finally, if there is any way that after winning the fight, the enemy disappears fluidly, it is that when the fight ends, the enemy is no longer there. If I chose delete event, the combat ends and the screen becomes clear, but the monster is still there and suddenly POPs and disappears, I want this to feel more fluid, i mean, it is no longer there when the combat is won.
Can someone help me? Thank you

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
Basically you'll need a script for event timers, then you can key the event behaviour to those timers.
forget about doing it with pure eventing - it would get much too complex to simuate the different timers with waits, and there is only one official game timer that is not enough.
for your specific sequences we'll have to see screenshots of how they are done in your event before we can correct any sudden changes.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
you don't need programming knowledge to use scripts.
you copy them into the script editor and then call them from events.
a minimal knowledge of ruby syntax might help for the more complex scripts, but most scripts have large help sections that tell you how to use them.
you can also read the tutorial "how to use a script" in my signature - a forum update several years back had messed up the formatting, but it should still be mostly readable.

posts.author: Zahawk
posts.body:
I have a similar chase system for the enemies in my game, the IMGs below have a slime that detects the player if they walk within 3 tiles, looses track of the player if player is over 6 tiles away, and initiates battle if within 1 tile. If win the slime disappears (no 'Pop'), and if escape the Slime becomes transparant for ~3 seconds before checking if the player is within 3 tiles to chase again.
The enemies in my game only spawn in when the player sleeps to the next day, the script call I use to turn on the Self Switch A of the Slime is;
Code:
$game_self_switches[[@map_id, @event_id, 'A']] = true

#Eg. Slime Event is ID 30 on Map 1
$game_self_switches[[1, 30, 'A']] = true
Note that this isn't a script(in the script editor), but a default VXAce script call(Event Command Script)
I also used a script by Vlue(V.M of D.T) called
Proximity Events
, which is what those conditional branches are refering to.
Code:
Proxy.inprox?(@event_id, value)
Hopefully this can be used as reference for your escape commands or that pop issue.

That code will allow you to turn on or off a self switch from another event. In my game monsters are inactive by default, only when their SelfSwitchA=On do they show up ingame. Each day the player sleeps a randomiser picks a few monsters to activate. (so I put that code on my bed's event)
Your events are setup slightly different, so you'd use this to respawn one of your monsters
$game_self_switches[[@map_id, @event_id, 'B']] = false
$game_self_switches[[@map_id, @event_id, 'A']] = false
Click to expand...
Just remember to switch out @event_id for the monster's event id that you're trying to respawn, and @map_id for the map its on

I define RM code in three different categories.
- Own Custom scripts (something I can't do)
- Other's Custom scripts (simple to use)
- Script Calls (also simple to use)
The Script Editor(F11) requires RGSS knowledge to create your own scripts, but you don't really need to know how to write RGSS if you're just using someone else's scripts.
Script Calls(EventCommand>Script) are exactly that, a call from a custom or default script in the script editor. I found that SelfSwitch Script Call in Archeia's
Script Call Collection for VXAce
.
PixelDarkKnight0193 said:
So your monsters spawn randomly? That is, in the same area, some monsters appear, but when you go to sleep, it is possible that others appear, is that right?
Click to expand...
Yes, a single monster has a group of three spawn locations, at random one is chosen and the monster is spawned. When the player next sleeps, the randomiser chooses again if it's the same spawn location and the player hasn't killed the monster then nothing happens, but if it rolls a location with no monster then that monster also spawns. So the population of monsters is always equal to the amount of monster groups I have, plus additional monsters if you don't cull them to keep the population in check. Also I've planned set it so that if you neglect culling monsters entirely, and all the monster groups fill up then emergency quests are issued or events are triggered, etc. The medicinal herbs and ore deposits in my game also refresh with this same mechanic.
